deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace, Multiverse Architect leads a patient planeswalker deck built around Reality Fracture's Jace tokens, shared loyalty abilities, life gain, and expendable creatures. Establish mana, build a screen of tokens, and use the Way enchantments to turn a growing planeswalker board into cards, creatures, and damage. Wins come through accumulated loyalty with Jace, Reality Sculptor, repeated drain from Sanctum Lurker, or a strengthened token army. Prioritize Jace, Reality Sculptor, Sanctum Lurker, and Way of the Mentor as three focal purchases. The deck gives up explosive starts and tutor-driven consistency for varied, board-based games; its four-color mana and reliance on support permanents reward careful sequencing.

The quality model grades this deck at the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
